title: Atlas identity-basis row
description: One value about a named record that its record has no field for: the term a rule-made ID is built from, or the claim (and word) that supports one value of an identity field with no claim field (instance_of, facility_kinds). Moved from four design-document tables in S14 (DT-1, D-110, D-117): concept-dataset.md §3 and §7, facility-dataset.md §2 and §4. The rules that use these rows stay in those documents (CI-1, PI-1, IO-1, FI-1, FK-1); the checks are tests/test_data_entities.py and tests/test_data_identity_basis.py. A row is flat (one value per field) so SQL can load it without unnesting. Status: proposed (S14, D-117).

concept_term.description: CI-1 (concept-dataset.md §3): a taxonomy concept mapped to a technology or component, the term its record's ID is built from, and its record, or the state no_record for a concept the Atlas holds as a gap.

note.description: The table's note, verbatim: a term question, a split's decision, or why a concept is a gap.

product_term.description: PI-1 (concept-dataset.md §7): the product name as the vendor writes it in an identity anchor, without the vendor's own name.

instance_of_basis.description: IO-1 (concept-dataset.md §7): the claim that supports one instance_of value of a product. The record stays the home of the value; this row is its evidence.

facility_term.description: FI-1 (facility-dataset.md §2): the site's own name as an identity anchor gives it, or, where the source names no site, its locality.

facility_kind_basis.description: FK-1 (facility-dataset.md §4): the identity claim and the word in its anchor that give one facility kind. The words each kind accepts are a rule and stay in facility-dataset.md §4.
